title: Orientalism: Between Fact and Fantasy
summary: About 180 works on how 19th-century Europe pictured the Middle East, hanging Gérôme, Delacroix and Ingres beside Islamic objects and the Ottoman painter Osman Hamdi Bey.

title: Krasner and Pollock: Past Continuous
summary: More than 120 paintings, works on paper and ephemera following Lee Krasner and Jackson Pollock side by side, each on their own terms.

title: Rembrandt’s Lions: Art and Exile in the Dutch Republic
summary: Drawings, etchings and paintings tracing migrants, exiles and refugees in Rembrandt’s Amsterdam and in his art.

title: Fantasy and Reality: The Art of Johan Tobias Sergel
summary: The first major show outside Europe for the Swedish sculptor: marble, terracotta and drawings, with works by friends including Fuseli and Romney.

title: Brancusi: The Artist and His Studio
summary: Constantin Brancusi’s sculpture seen through the studio where he made, arranged and photographed it.

title: The Surrealist Book
summary: Artists’ books, prints and publications from the Surrealist movement.

title: Art of Manga
summary: About 600 original drawings in the first large exhibition in the Americas to treat manga as an art form.

title: Manga Before Manga: Japanese Art from the Collection
summary: Twenty-one works from the museum’s Japanese collection showing where manga’s visual language came from.

title: Hopi Kachina Dolls: Blessings for a Balanced World
summary: The kachina doll tradition seen from the perspective of the Hopi girls who receive them.

title: Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses
summary: The Dutch designer’s first major New York exhibition: couture that behaves like sculpture.

title: Yoshitomo Nara
summary: Nara’s first solo show with the gallery and his return to New York after nearly a decade, across both Chelsea spaces.

title: Sotheby’s Masters Week preview
summary: Free public viewing of Old Master paintings, drawings and sculpture before the winter sales.

title: Christie’s Classic Week preview
summary: Free public viewing of Old Master paintings and sculpture ahead of Christie’s winter sales.

title: The Winter Show 2027
summary: America’s leading art, antiques and design fair, with dealers covering thousands of years.

title: TEFAF New York 2027
summary: A vetted fair of about 90 dealers, from antiquities and Old Masters to modern and contemporary art.
